name: is.memoised
title: Test whether a function is memoised

origin.description: Report whether memoise returned this function.
origin.example:
f <- function(x) x
m <- memoise(f)
cat(paste(as.integer(is.memoised(f)), as.integer(is.memoised(m))), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Report whether memoise returned this function.
translation.example:
from memoise import *
def f(x):
    return x

m = memoise(f)
print(int(is_memoised(f)), int(is_memoised(m)))
